top_fixes.rule: Outcome/reason/closing-sentence table: each situation maps to an outcome, reason code and closing sentence said verbatim.
top_fixes.why: A transfer that comes after a recorded arrangement (for example 'can I speak to someone' in wrapup, or hardship after recording) closes as promise/FULLPTP|PARTPTP, or with a blank reason, when it should close as transferred/XRST|XGEN|XCARE. That fails the close_call check on every transfer-after-recording case (this also covers R78, R80, R81, R82, R74 and R95).
top_fixes.fix: In the code of fin_transferred_restructuring, fin_transferred_human and fin_transferred_support, delete the `if rec and rec.lower() not in ('none','null'): vars['outcome']='promise'; vars['reason']=promise_reason` branch. Always set vars['outcome']='transferred' and vars['reason'] to 'XRST', 'XGEN' or 'XCARE' respectively. In close_call pre_process_code, never drop or blank `reason`.

top_fixes.rule: Before recording, read back and record only after a clear yes; on a change, check the new value and read back again. With several products, agree, read back and record each before the next.
top_fixes.why: With several products the agent agrees all of them first and then reads them back and records them together, so the read-back, create_promise and 'Your payment arrangement is recorded.' sequence is in the wrong order for every multi-product case (this also covers R30 and R31).
top_fixes.fix: In the policy code, change advance(). As soon as a product reaches state 'agreed', go to confirm and read back "So that is {amount} for your {product} on {weekday, day month}. Is that right?". Call create_promise only after a clear yes. Only then call start_product(V, opn[0]) for the next open product. In ev_rec_after, speak "Your payment arrangement is recorded." right after each ok:true, not once in enter_wrapup. After the 2nd failure, speak "I'm sorry, I could not record that." right away (also when nothing else was recorded, before fin_sysf), then add_note service_error and continue with the next product.

top_fixes.rule: No arrangement, product(s) turned down, second-look call booked: no_promise / TDN2L.
top_fixes.why: The terminal farewells say extra words beyond the mandated closing sentence, so the verbatim closing check fails on every second-look and deceased case (this also covers R17 and R91).
top_fixes.fix: Set end_tdn2l spoken_message to exactly "Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Speak to you then. Goodbye." Move the booking sentence "Your second-look call is booked for {{second_look_text}} at {{sl_time}}." into offer_second_look, to be spoken after schedule_callback succeeds, before the transition to fin_tdn2l. Set end_deceased spoken_message to exactly "I am very sorry to hear that."

top_fixes.rule: Several products, nothing recorded, no transfer: all claimed paid → CLMPD; otherwise most serious decides in order SYSF, HDNX, DSPT, TDN2L, TDN. Paid next to turned-down is TDN or TDN2L.
top_fixes.why: With several products, finalize() takes the ending from the first non-paid product in list order, not from the most serious one, so mixed cases (for example refused + dispute, or paid + hardship-declined) get the wrong no_promise reason code.
top_fixes.fix: In policy code finalize(), when nothing is recorded and there is no transfer: if every product is 'paid', close CLMPD. Otherwise pick the key by severity across all product states, in this order: service_error→SYSF, hardship_declined→HDNX, dispute→DSPT, refused with second look booked→TDN2L, refused/notalk→TDN. Treat 'paid' next to 'refused' as TDN/TDN2L. Also send any 'refused' product to fin_secondlook before closing, even if another product was recorded (R32).

top_fixes.rule: `add_note` reason is one of `refused`, `hardship`, `dispute`, `paid`, `service_error`, and text must contain the specified content per reason.
top_fixes.why: add_note only sends product_id and reason, so the required note content is never stored. Every refused/hardship/dispute/paid/service_error note case fails (this also covers R34, R35, R39, R59 and R31).
top_fixes.fix: Add a body field `text` (default "{{note_text}}") to the add_note tool. In note_next(), set vars['note_text'] per reason: refused → f"{attempts_used} attempts; last offer {prop_amount} on {prop_date}"; hardship → the customer's words (new extraction field hardship_words); dispute → what is disputed (extraction dispute_what); paid → how and when paid (extraction paid_how_when); service_error → f"create_promise failed after {create_promise_failure_count} tries". Also, in ev_settle, remove the multi(V) condition so "Thank you. A payment can take up to two business days to reach us." is spoken on single-product calls too.
